name: learning-companion
description: Turns the code Claude writes into lessons, quizzes and spaced-repetition reviews (SM-2), tied to roadmaps of what you want to learn.

lessonModel.title: Lesson model
lessonModel.description: Model for roadmaps, lessons and quizzes. Haiku is fast and cheap; Sonnet and Opus teach in more depth.

autoLessons.title: Lessons while you work
autoLessons.description: Start a lesson when Claude uses a due concept. Off: only /learn and /practice start lessons.

maxLessonsPerDay.title: Automatic lessons per day
maxLessonsPerDay.description: How many automatic lessons a day at most; 0 for no limit. /learn and /practice are not limited.

notesDir.title: Notes folder
notesDir.description: Where each lesson is saved as Markdown, one file per concept, including any code it quotes (secrets redacted). Empty: no notes.
